description: The patella is the sesamoid kneecap that rides within the quadriceps tendon and broadens the knee's anterior plane for clear highlights.

landmarks.name: Base of the patella
landmarks.desc: Broad superior edge where the quadriceps tendon blends into the sesamoid.

landmarks.name: Apex of the patella
landmarks.desc: Pointed inferior tip that leads into the patellar ligament toward the tibial tuberosity.

landmarks.name: Medial articular facet
landmarks.desc: Medial posterior facet that glides against the femoral trochlea and softens the knee's inner profile.

landmarks.name: Lateral articular facet
landmarks.desc: Broader lateral posterior facet that keeps the patella tracking true along the femur.
